Experiment_description: Initial experiments using simple neural networks on synthetic datasets to predict Review Quality Scores (RQS) as a proxy for improving AI conference peer review processes.
Significance: These experiments are crucial for developing a framework that can enhance peer review processes by accurately predicting reviewer quality using machine learning techniques. They provide insights into model performance, data quality, and potential areas for optimization.
Description: Synthetic datasets were created to simulate peer review characteristics, and simple neural networks were trained on these datasets to predict RQS. The experiments tracked metrics like training and validation loss, accuracy, and RQS to evaluate model performance.
